short: A King George V-class battleship, HMS Prince of Wales fought Bismarck before being sunk by Japanese aircraft off Malaya.
full:
Commissioned in early 1941, HMS Prince of Wales was one of Britain's newest and most advanced battleships, though she entered service with civilian contractors still aboard fixing mechanical issues. In May 1941, she accompanied HMS Hood into the Denmark Strait, scoring three vital hits on the German battleship Bismarck before being forced to retreat with heavy damage.

Later that year, Prince of Wales was deployed to Singapore as the flagship of Force Z to deter Japanese aggression in Southeast Asia. On 10 December 1941, lacking air cover, the battleship and the battlecruiser HMS Repulse were intercepted by land-based Japanese bombers and torpedo planes. Both ships were sunk in the open sea, starkly demonstrating the newfound dominance of air power over unprotected capital ships.
